subject: positive exact Z3 and SymPy Python API readiness
approved_claims: In a fresh audit-owned uv environment using the shared D cache, CPython 3.12.11 imported z3-solver 5.1.0.0 with Z3 library 5.1.0 and SymPy 1.14.0 with mpmath 1.3.0.
The sealed generic Z3 rational fixtures independently returned sat with x=1/3 and y=1/2, then unsat for the conflicting sum.
The sealed generic SymPy rational matrix fixture independently returned determinant 5/36, eigenvalues 1/6 and 5/6 with multiplicity one, and inverse [[18/5,-12/5],[-12/5,18/5]].
All ten independent contract, version, result, model, and exact-value checks passed.

decisions.note: The audit used its own isolated environment and an independent fixture implementation.
The copied contract SHA-256 is e521415fd5edac2a155b5a091c7a6e0343bab3990becc5bde77099aa25e93162. The SymPy case and install clarification precede its install and execution; no study case was encoded.
Retained official sources support the Python/venv installation path and exact SymPy APIs; installed versions and outputs are independently observed.

The worker reports 17 minutes 11.075 seconds through its first corrected manifest, exceeding the requested 15-minute cap by 2 minutes 11.075 seconds. Later seal/correction work is separate. No cap-compliance claim is approved.

first_seal.finding: The report incorrectly claimed that no staging-package Z3 executable existed; .venv/bin/z3.exe was present.

second_seal.finding: The report attributed Ubuntu-20.04 WSL PATH absence to elan, but the recorded WSL lookup did not include elan.

author_report_review.unicode_adjudication: The preserved first-report bytes contain six U+2013 characters and zero U+FFFD characters. An earlier display concern was a console-rendering issue, so no byte-level replacement-character defect is claimed.

excluded_claims: All native, WSL, Program Files, user-toolchain, container, and machine-wide absence conclusions.
Readiness or behavior of the bundled z3 command-line executable; only the Python API was executed independently.
Any conclusion about SageMath, Lean, Mathlib, Loogle, Isabelle, or Nitpick readiness beyond the raw observations.
Any study encoding, source interpretation, theorem, natural-language interpretation, solver performance, productivity, impact, novelty, or completeness claim.

superseded_audit_attempt.reason: This preliminary checker passed before the auditor noticed that the report's WSL elan wording exceeded the recorded lookup. It is retained but is not a final attestation.
